configuration.cpu: user+system delta / per-PID monotonic interval; percent of one CPU, summed by role
configuration.frame_probe: disabled after first validated frame; no sampling thread/timer during idle
configuration.full_start: before server uv.spawn through readiness probe, native PTY/layout setup and Studio spawn to first validated terminal present
configuration.home: controlled private homes; shared-existing reuses warmup initialized HOME across startup trials; shared-new uses one new HOME per pair; separate-new uses independent new homes
configuration.resource_home: one new shared home per resource scenario; sampled after app initialization
configuration.resource_scope: server, Studio and explicitly owned fixture PIDs; coordinator/sampler/other helpers excluded
configuration.rss: resident bytes; role sums do not deduplicate shared pages
configuration.rtt: native client request call through complete decoded health reply; new UDS connection each time; separate server process
configuration.server_ready: before uv.spawn to first fully decoded healthy /health reply; 1ms socket observation and safe readiness GET retries included

configuration.startup_trace_cost: opt-in phase clocks and stderr writes perturb startup; keep uninstrumented latency alongside attribution
configuration.studio_ready: before uv.spawn to first RGB-validated SDL present API return; ready-file observation excluded
configuration.topology: balanced split tree, first pane zoomed, ALL N views attached
